Initial release.

- Outputs include tailored responses, reusable checklists, and verification notes.
- Triggered by keywords related to work productivity, web search, and bug fixing needs.

- Initial public release of the work-productivity-tavily-web-workflow-helper skill.
- Helps users build, debug, and improve Tavily 搜索-style workflows, focusing on work productivity and web search tasks.
- Addresses validated demand from agent users for practical support such as bug fixes, reliability improvements, and creation of related skills.
